## CANDIDATE CONFLICTS (PHASE 1-5)

### Candidate Conflict 1
- Category: Funding Amount Discrepancy
- Description: Phase 1 Open Threads dan Phase 3 EV-003 menyatakan funding amount tidak diungkapkan resmi di blog Blast, hanya media reports (The Block, CoinDesk) menyebut $20M–$30M. Phase 5 Funding History mencatat amount $20,000,000–$30,000,000 USD dengan sources The Block & CoinDesk (MEDIUM). Namun Phase 5 Official Blog Disclosure Funding Round mencatat Amount "tidak diungkap" dengan source Blog Introducing Blast (HIGH). Terdapat perbedaan presentasi: Phase 5 menampilkan amount dari media sebagai "Funding History" utama, sedangkan blog resmi tidak mengonfirmasi amount.
- Severity: Medium
- Affected Phase: Phase 3, Phase 5
- Evidence: Phase 3 EV-003 Sources: The Block (MEDIUM), CoinDesk (MEDIUM) — "Jumlah pasti tidak diungkapkan resmi di blog Blast; laporan media menyebut total funding ~$20M–$30M". Phase 5 Funding History: Amount $20M–$30M Sources The Block (MEDIUM), CoinDesk (MEDIUM); Official Blog Disclosure: Amount tidak diungkap Source Blog Introducing Blast (HIGH).
- Sources: https://www.theblock.co/post/264000/blur-founder-launches-blast-ethereum-layer-2, https://www.coindesk.com/business/2023/11/20/blur-founder-launches-blast-ethereum-layer-2, https://blog.blast.io/introducing-blast

### Candidate Conflict 2
- Category: Treasury Transparency Gap
- Description: Phase 1 Foundation tidak mencatat treasury size. Phase 2 Entity Blast Foundation deskripsi "Mengelola treasury, tokenomics, dan governance protokol" tapi tidak ada size. Phase 3 EV-016 Governance Proposal 1 menyebut "Foundation Treasury Management" tapi detail tidak diverifikasi. Phase 4 Technology Upgrade Control menyatakan "Admin control oleh Blast Foundation multisig (address tidak dipublikasikan resmi)". Phase 5 Financial: Current Treasury Size "tidak diungkap", Treasury Composition "tidak diungkap", Treasury Custodian "tidak diungkap", Financial Risk "Treasury Concentration/Opaque Treasury Management" dengan source blog & docs no transparency report. Seluruh phase konsisten bahwa treasury tidak transparan, TAPI tidak ada konflik antar phase — ini confirmation of gap bukan conflict. Namun Phase 2 menyebut Blast Foundation "Mengelola treasury" imply treasury exists, Phase 5 says "tidak diungkap" — konsisten.
- Severity: Low (ini confirmation of disclosure gap, bukan konflik data)
- Affected Phase: Phase 1, 2, 3, 4, 5
- Evidence: Phase 2 Blast Foundation deskripsi "Mengelola treasury"; Phase 4 Upgrade Control "address tidak dipublikasikan resmi"; Phase 5 Treasury Size "tidak diungkap" Sources blog.blast.io (HIGH), docs.blast.io (HIGH).
- Sources: https://blog.blast.io/introducing-blast, https://docs.blast.io, https://blog.blast.io/blast-mainnet-launch

- Category: Investor Entity Missing in Phase 2
- Description: Paradigm dan Standard Crypto muncul sebagai participant di Phase 3 EV-003 (Funding Round) dan Financial Dependency di Phase 5, namun tidak terdaftar sebagai entity terpisah di Phase 2 Entity Inventory. - Sources: https://www.theblock.co/post/264000/blur-founder-launches-blast-ethereum-layer-2, https://www.coindesk.com/business/2023/11/20/blur-founder-launches-blast-ethereum-layer-2, https://blog.blast.io/introducing-blast (Phase 2 entity list)

## Technical Decision Pattern

Decision: Choose Optimistic Rollup (OP Stack fault proof) over ZK Rollup  
Reason: Faster time-to-market; EVM equivalence easier; OP Stack battle-tested (Optimism, Base); native yield implementation simpler pada optimistic model  
Evidence: Architecture docs describe Optimistic Rollup dengan 7-day challenge; DisputeGame menggunakan Cannon/MIPS dari OP Stack (HIGH) [Blast Docs Architecture, https://docs.blast.io/architecture] [Blast GitHub DisputeGame, https://github.com/blastL2/contracts/blob/main/src/L1/DisputeGame.sol]  
Sources: https://docs.blast.io/architecture, https://github.com/blastL2/contracts/blob/main/src/L1/DisputeGame.sol

Decision: Implement native yield via custom precompile (0x4300...0004) rebasing mechanism bukan ERC-4626 vault  
Reason: Gas efficiency (rebasing per block tanpa user tx); automatic untuk semua address (no opt-in); composability dengan existing DeFi (token balance increases natively)  
Evidence: NativeYieldPrecompile adalah ERC-20 precompile dengan rebasing logic; docs describe "automatic yield to all addresses" (HIGH) [Blast Docs Native Yield Technical, https://docs.blast.io/native-yield/technical-details] [Blastscan NativeYieldPrecompile, https://blastscan.io/address/0x4300000000000000000000000000000000000004]  
Sources: https://docs.blast.io/native-yield/technical-details, https://blastscan.io/address/0x4300000000000000000000000000000000000004

Decision: Use centralized sequencer (single) dengan roadmap ke decentralization unspecified  
Reason: Simplicity, low latency, deterministic ordering untuk launch; decentralized sequencer (shared/BoLD) masih R&D di industry  
Evidence: Docs state "single sequencer operated by Foundation"; no forced inclusion contract found in GitHub (HIGH) [Blast Docs Sequencer, https://docs.blast.io/architecture/sequencer] [Blast GitHub Contracts, https://github.com/blastL2/contracts]  
Sources: https://docs.blast.io/architecture/sequencer, https://github.com/blastL2/contracts

Decision: Keep proposer/challenger permissioned (Foundation whitelist)  
Reason: Safety during early mainnet; fraud proof system (Cannon) complex; permissionless challenge game requires more testing  
Evidence: L2OutputOracle dan DisputeGame contracts have owner/whitelist access control; no permissionless challenge game live (HIGH) [Blast GitHub L2OutputOracle, https://github.com/blastL2/contracts/blob/main/src/L1/L2OutputOracle.sol] [Blast GitHub DisputeGame, https://github.com/blastL2/contracts/blob/main/src/L1/DisputeGame.sol]  
Sources: https://github.com/blastL2/contracts/blob/main/src/L1/L2OutputOracle.sol, https://github.com/blastL2/contracts/blob/main/src/L1/DisputeGame.sol

Decision: Depend on Chainlink price feeds untuk yield oracle (stETH/ETH, USDS/USD)  
Reason: Chainlink is industry standard, battle-tested, decentralized oracle network; no need to build custom oracle  
Evidence: Docs describe yield rate oracle menggunakan Chainlink feeds; no fallback oracle documented (MEDIUM) [Blast Docs Native Yield Oracle, https://docs.blast.io/native-yield/oracle]  
Sources: https://docs.blast.io/native-yield/oracle

Decision: Not open-source execution client (blast-geth)  
Reason: Competitive advantage? Security through obscurity? Not disclosed. Industry trend: OP Stack clients open source (op-geth), but Blast custom fork may have proprietary optimizations  
Evidence: GitHub org blastL2 has contracts, SDK, but no blast-geth repo visible (LOW) [Blast GitHub Org, https://github.com/blastL2]  
Sources: https://github.com/blastL2

Decision: Canonical bridge only supports token transfer (ETH, ERC-20, ERC-721), no arbitrary messaging  
Reason: Simpler security model; arbitrary messaging adds complexity and attack surface; third-party protocols (LayerZero, Wormhole) fill this gap  
Evidence: Bridge docs state "native bridge only supports token transfer"; third-party bridges listed separately (HIGH) [Blast Docs Bridge, https://docs.blast.io/bridge]
